reason: The original plan named RO-Crate 1.3 as an official target, but the RO-Crate community's current Recommendation is 1.2 and the 1.3 profile URI does not identify a released specification. The unsupported-profile result exposed a planning error rather than a validator lag. This amendment corrects the derived packaging view to the actual stable standard without changing any native Vela object, source Claim, Decision, authority boundary, or Standing.

amendment.representation: Generate an attached RO-Crate 1.2 metadata view over the unchanged native manifest and exact 11-object set.
amendment.reader_result: Require the off-the-shelf roc-validator 0.11.3 RO-Crate 1.2 profile to pass all REQUIRED checks and retain its deterministic JSON report summary.
amendment.publication: Replace only the derived RO-Crate metadata, loss report, reader result, aggregate result, and SHA256SUMS. Preserve the superseded 1.3 result in Git history and name this correction in current documentation.
amendment.authority: RO-Crate conformance remains supporting interoperability evidence only and cannot verify Vela signatures, scientific truth, or Standing.

unchanged: Source native manifest, object-set root, object count, Claim, Decision, and authority boundary.
All mutation, determinism, loss-report, and no-authority requirements.
No Frontier mutation, credential use, Proposal import, Verification import, or local Decision.
The original plan and amendment remain immutable audit evidence of the corrected planning error.
stop_conditions: The validator requires a network fetch or profile substitution.
Any native Vela object, root, identity, authority evidence, or Standing changes.
The generated RO-Crate omits a native object or implies Vela authority.
Any REQUIRED RO-Crate 1.2 validation check fails.
